config_dir.description: The directory where Pidgin stores its configuration files.

force_online.description: Try to be online even if the network is reported to be unavailable.

multiple_instances.description: Allow multiple instances of Pidgin to run simultaneously.

no_autologin.description: Don't automatically login when Pidgin starts.

show_system_tray.description: Show a Pidgin icon in the notification area.

hide_new_im.description: Hide new IM messages until the user explicitly views them.

tabbed_windows.description: Show IM and chat sessions in windows with multiple tabs.

show_close_buttons.description: Show close buttons on conversation tabs.

enable_buddy_animation.description: Enable animation for buddy icons if they are animated.

typing_notifications.description: Notify buddies that you are typing to them.

log_format.description: Specify how to log messages (html or text).

log_status_changes.description: Log all status changes to the system log.

accounts.description: List of account configurations to be managed by Pidgin. This simulates accounts.xml entries for automation templates where direct XML generation isn't preferred, but rather a structured representation of account parameters.
